description: Author-created, frozen fictional sources. example.test URLs identify fixtures and are never fetched. This benchmark isolates grounded generation; it does not evaluate live retrieval or PDF parsing.

sources.title: Helio pilot report
sources.text: The synthetic Helio pilot enrolled 48 participants. Of these, 36 completed onboarding. The pilot ran from 1 March to 31 March 2026. Eight people submitted feedback. Feedback was optional. The report does not measure revenue, satisfaction scores, or causal effects.

sources.title: Helio latency experiment
sources.text: On a fixed 100-request synthetic workload, configuration A had median latency 800 ms and p95 latency 1600 ms. Configuration B had median latency 650 ms and p95 latency 1900 ms. Both configurations returned 98 successful responses. These measurements exclude network transit and cold starts.

sources.title: Helio pricing draft
sources.text: The draft Basic plan costs 12 EUR per month and permits 3 seats. The draft Team plan costs 30 EUR per month and permits 10 seats. Annual billing discounts, taxes, and prices in currencies other than EUR are not specified. These are draft prices, not a public offer.

sources.title: Helio retention policy
sources.text: Synthetic research history is retained for 30 days. Application audit events are retained for 180 days. Uploaded PDF bytes are processed in memory and are not retained as files. The policy does not state whether extracted PDF text appears in saved reports. A deletion request is acknowledged within 2 business days; this is not a guarantee of completed deletion.

sources.title: Helio release note, 1 April
sources.text: The release note dated 1 April 2026 says the upload limit is 5 MB and lists English as the only interface language. It provides no indication that its upload limit applies to later releases.

sources.title: Helio release note, 15 April
sources.text: The release note dated 15 April 2026 raises the upload limit to 8 MB and adds French to the existing English interface. The new limit applies from 15 April 2026.

sources.title: Helio access design
sources.text: Every synthetic project is owned by one account. An account can view only its own projects. Support staff can inspect service health but cannot read report contents through the support interface. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes; password reset links expire after 20 minutes and can be used once. This design document is not an audit or certification.

sources.title: Helio capacity test
sources.text: A synthetic single-process test handled 120 requests per minute with a 2% error rate. The test used an in-memory data store and mocked external model responses. It does not establish production throughput or real model quality.
